market.ai_summaries.layer_note: generated company summaries, written on demand by the companies API route and cached for display; no scheduled producer and no run attribution, so it is not a computed measure

market.pipeline_runs.layer_note: run-level telemetry written by the daily pipeline; carries no business data

market.pipeline_step_runs.layer_note: per-step telemetry written by the daily pipeline; carries no business data

market.scheduler_job_runs.layer_note: per-run telemetry written by app/workers/pipeline_tracker.py for the scheduler jobs; carries no business data

screener.saved_screens.layer_note: user-authored screen definitions, keyed on user_id and written by the saved_screens API route; not produced by any pipeline job
